messages:
maya_cs: heads up — Signet (acct SG-102) renewal in procurement queue today. They want net-60 + KMS onboarding on the SOW. Procurement is asking to split the invoice across the UK and EU legal entities, and they flagged VAT/tax id mismatch. We need legal + finance sign-off by EOD Fri or they may ask for a price hold. @olivia_revops can you confirm vendor code status?

luca_sa: thanks maya. do we have a PO number yet? also who owns vendor code mapping on our side? if finance needs docs i can pull historical invoices. :eyes:

olivia_revops: vendor code is pending — finance needs the EU tax id from Signet (customer provided a UK tax id only). I pinged Signet procurement earlier but no reply. DocuSign flow is ready once legal approves the entity split. I can draft a two-invoice addendum if legal approves that approach. @maya_cs any constraints from the SOW side (deliverables tied to a single entity)?

maya_cs: deliverables are fine to split (we bill per-seat and training per-entity). SOW line items: 50 seats + onboarding + KMS key integration. snippet of PO details below: ```PO: SIGNET-2026-88321
Amount: $120,000 (split 70/30 UK/EU)
Billing term: Net 60
KMS: customer-managed, will need KMS key ARN and onboarding window```

sam_prod: noted — enablement is scheduled week-of-4/18. if billing changes push timeline, we can flex training start by 1 week. i'll prep acceptance checklist so finance has evidence for go-live. :thumbsup:

luca_sa: ok i can surface the historical vendor code and help reconcile tax id. who should i loop in from legal? @olivia_revops do you want @legal-team or should i jump in?

olivia_revops: please loop legal-team and finance-ops. i'll assemble the two-invoice addendum draft and attach the DocuSign placeholders. once legal signs off, docusign-bot will send the envelope.

docusign-bot: Document 'Redwood_SOW_Signet_v3' prepared and queued for envelope creation. Waiting on 'legal-team' approval to attach second invoice.

maya_cs: appreciated. i'll follow up with Signet procurement for EU tax id and ask them to confirm which legal entity signs. if we don't have legal + finance sign-off by noon Thu i'll escalate to legal lead to unblock. updating thread as things land. :spiral_calendar:
